free_tier.stated: Pay as you go. $250 in credit. No card required. Early access includes $250 in credit, and you do not need a card.
free_tier.notes: The $250 is an early-access credit on a private-preview service, not a permanent free plan. Compute is $0.0436 per vCPU-hour, $0.0096 per GiB-hour of memory and $0.0001 per GiB-hour of storage, billed per second; a typical 1 vCPU/1 GiB/4 GiB disk agent-hour is about $0.054. Pausing a sandbox stops the CPU and memory charge.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the billed unit is allocated vCPU, memory and disk time, not an object; no per-object cap is published

retention.stated: Files can be mounted from a bucket and kept after the run ends; no retention period for sandbox files is published.
retention.notes: Snapshots freeze a ready machine so every new task boots from it in about 25 ms.

egress.terms: not published: the pricing section states no egress allowance or price; the network policy is default deny and only named hosts and ports are reachable

interface_detail: Eight native APIs cover terminal/PTY, code, files, storage, git, browser, computer and snapshots; Python SDK, TypeScript SDK and CLI are offered, with SSH access listed as a feature.
tooling: the Gravix Layer Python SDK (github.com/gravixlayer/gravixlayer-python), TypeScript SDK and CLI; sandboxes, browsers and computers are each created with one call.
chaining: Sandbox, browser and computer run on one platform with a shared network policy and MCP gateway, so a hosted agent can use all three surfaces under one account; the vendor-managed multi-cloud lane is the hosted offer, while bring-your-own-cloud and on-premises AI Factory are roadmap items and are not recommendations here.

limits.value: $250 of early-access credit at $0.0436 per vCPU-hour, $0.0096 per GiB-hour memory and $0.0001 per GiB-hour storage
network policy is default deny: only named hosts and ports are reachable

binding_note: The $250 early-access credit is the first limit reached at published rates, ahead of any unpublished session or concurrency cap; pausing stops the CPU and memory charge.

identity_cost.detail: The early-access form says 'Email is all we need' and asks for Email; the site says 'Gravix Layer is in private preview. Request access from this site. You do not need a card to start.' No phone, ID or institution is named.

reliability_note: Private preview with a request-access gate; hardware-isolated microVMs and a default-deny network policy; one sandbox cannot read another's files; no published SLA.
confidence_note: The rates, $250 credit, no-card statement and email-only access form are quoted from the vendor's own pages read 2026-11-25; the service is still private preview.
